name: Hitomi Vision
description: Hitomi Vision — an optometry clinic theme for office workers and school-age children. A low-chroma sage-grey ground with a pale dome (a lens-like arc) behind every section head, two 2:3 portrait rows with a narrow caption column that alternate left and right, a pair of polaroid-style case photographs offset by 110 px, and a framed photograph window under a headline set on pale strips. The home page tells one argument: eyestrain symptoms at work and at school, the sixty-minute exam method, one corrected case, the fees, the people and the visit. Newsreader for reading and headings, Figtree for labels. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA text colours; quiet scroll reveals that stop under reduced motion.
